{"seon.dev.mcp/namespace":"scratch.astra.store","seon.dev.mcp/session-id":"default","seon.dev.mcp/cluster":"default","seon.dev.mcp/mode":"jvm","seon.dev.mcp/events":[{"tag":"ret","val":"#:seon.dev.mcp{:value [{:case 1, :mismatches 1, :same-verdict true, :results [{:reads 5, :ms 331.961791, :total-ms 337.570333, :checked 17922, :edges 108131} {:reads 3, :ms 2.280333, :total-ms 3.314292, :checked 2, :edges 3}]} {:case 10, :mismatches 10, :same-verdict true, :results [{:reads 5, :ms 170.8375, :total-ms 174.142542, :checked 17931, :edges 108140} {:reads 3, :ms 0.941167, :total-ms 2.045, :checked 11, :edges 12}]} {:case 100, :mismatches 100, :same-verdict true, :results [{:reads 5, :ms 179.710709, :total-ms 183.446084, :checked 18021, :edges 108230} {:reads 3, :ms 0.943958, :total-ms 2.453167, :checked 101, :edges 102}]}], :windowed? false}","ns":"scratch.astra.store","ms":751}],"seon.dev.mcp/runtime":"clj","seon.dev.mcp/cluster-state":"advertised","seon.dev.mcp/form":"(let [held (:seon.store/store (#'boot/selected-instance "default"))
 base (db/db (boot/connection "default")) branch (keyword (str "astra-arity-" (id/id)))
 _ (registry/branch! {:seon.store/store held :seon.store/branch branch :seon.cluster.registry/from (:datahike.value/commit-id (db/committed-value-identity base))})
 conn (store/open-branch! held branch)]
 (try
  (let [database (db/db conn) projection (db/carried-projection database)
        caller (:db/id (db/pull database [:db/id] [:seon.fn/sym 'seon.id/evaluation]))
        arities (:seon.fn/arities (db/pull database [{:seon.fn/arities [:db/id]}] [:seon.fn/sym 'seon.id/id]))
        cases (mapv (fn [n] [n (into [[:db/add caller :seon.fn/calls 'seon.id/id]] (map #(vector :db/add caller :seon.fn/call-arities ['seon.id/id (+ 1000 %)])) (range n))]) [1 10 100])]
    (mapv (fn [[label tx]]
      (let [report (d/with database tx)
            _ (evict-kinds-after! #{:seon.db/arity-base :seon.db/arity-revision :seon.db/arity-commit})
            answers (mapv (fn [f] (let [start (System/nanoTime)
                              counted (batch/sink) comparison (binding [batch/*world* {:seon.batch/sink counted}] (f projection report))
                              compared (/ (- (System/nanoTime) start) 1e6)
                              result (#'db/arity-verdict (:db-after report) projection report comparison)]
                         {:reads (get (batch/calls counted) 'seon.db/storage-q-in 0) :ms compared :total-ms (/ (- (System/nanoTime) start) 1e6) :checked (:seon.db/checked comparison) :edges (:seon.db/edges comparison) :verdict result}))
                          [#'db/report-arity-comparison touched-arity-comparison])
            verdicts (mapv #(get-in % [:verdict :seon.fn/arity-mismatches]) answers)]
        (assert (every? vector? verdicts))
        (assert (apply = verdicts))
        {:case label :mismatches (count (first verdicts)) :same-verdict true
         :results (mapv #(dissoc % :verdict) answers)})) cases))
  (finally (store/release-branch! conn)
           (registry/retire-branch! {:seon.store/store held :seon.store/branch branch}))))","seon.dev.mcp/root":"/Users/sean/src/seon"}
